title: Hue in a day
summary: Sleep on the south bank. Cross for the Imperial City when the gate opens, eat bún bò Huế at Dong Ba, and at dusk walk from Truong Tien Bridge to Nghinh Luong Dinh.

stops.name: Hue Citadel
stops.note: Go at opening: 06:30 from 16 March to 15 October, and 07:00 from 16 October to 15 March (conservation centre notice, March 2024). Confirm the posted hours at the gate. An adult ticket is 200,000 VND and does not cover the tombs.

stops.name: Bun bo Hue
stops.note: Eat bún bò Huế inside Dong Ba, the city market, then stay for the small cakes: bánh khoái and bánh bèo.

stops.name: Perfume River walk
stops.note: At dusk, walk the river path from Truong Tien Bridge to Nghinh Luong Dinh, the old royal landing.

seoTitle: Hue in a day — citadel opening and the river at dusk
seoDescription: One day in Hue: the Imperial City when the gate opens, bún bò Huế at Dong Ba, and the river walk from Truong Tien Bridge to Nghinh Luong Dinh at dusk.
